findings: Mark P is exactly ZMod n ⊕ Visit P. Visit is the sigma type of an actual unordered geometric crossing and an edge in its proved two-member support. Original vertices and all crossing visits are retained, rather than only selected visits or an arbitrary finite word.

markPosition puts vertex i at the half-open traversal point (i,0) and every visit at its canonical crossing parameter on its actual traversed edge. The two evaluation lemmas identify these positions with P i and the visit's own crossingPoint. This is an actual traversal embedding, not an assertion that distinct visits have distinct points in the plane: paired visits correctly share one planar point.

markPosition_injective checks all four sum-constructor cases. Vertex equality follows from edge labels; each mixed case is impossible because every crossing parameter is strictly positive; visit equality follows from the existing Generic position-injectivity theorem, whose crossing-point argument uses G2 to exclude coincident distinct crossings. Thus the stronger Generic premise is used where G1 alone would not establish the needed injectivity.

markKey is the canonical real key edge.val+parameter, so it increases along each directed edge and places its parameter-zero vertex before its strictly interior visits. Half-open parameters distinguish consecutive edge readings. traversalKey_injective composed with position injectivity yields a genuine linear order of actual marks; the zero-based label cut changes neither orientation nor the intended circular reading.

markList is Finset.univ.sort under that induced order. Nodup and mem_markList establish that each actual mark occurs exactly once. markList_sorted gives nondecreasing keys, which become strictly ordered at distinct marks by markKey_injective. markList_length counts n original vertices plus two actual visits per crossing.
